# Realtrix

> Realtrix runs a complete managed cold email outbound operation for B2B SaaS and automation companies: infrastructure, list sourcing, sequencing, and AI-qualified replies. Infrastructure is billed at cost, with a fee only when a real reply lands.

Canonical site: https://realtrix.org
Contact: trevor@realtrix.org

## Services
- [Done-For-You Cold Email](https://realtrix.org/services/done-for-you-cold-email): Domain setup, list building, copywriting, and inbox management.
- [Cold Email Automation Setup](https://realtrix.org/services/cold-email-automation-setup): DNS, warmup, CRM integration, and sequence templates.
- [Email Deliverability Consulting](https://realtrix.org/services/email-deliverability-consulting): DNS audit, sender reputation recovery, and inbox placement.
- [B2B Lead Generation](https://realtrix.org/services/b2b-lead-generation): ICP definition, prospect sourcing, enrichment, and reply management.
- [Multi-Touch Outreach](https://realtrix.org/services/multi-touch-outreach): Email, phone, and LinkedIn in one coordinated cadence.
